headline: Veranda Learning Solutions submits regulatory disclosure to the exchange
hook: Routine regulatory filing from Veranda Learning
summary: Veranda Learning Solutions Limited has submitted a disclosure to the stock exchange under Regulation 30 of SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements.
